description:
Problem: `benchbox run --force datagen|upload|all` and `--platform-option force_recreate=true` drop the target database on remote platforms (drop_database on Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks, Redshift and others). Owner decision (2026-11-14): --force already implies the user understands the impact, so behaviour stays as it is. The remaining gap is that the help text does not say what each value deletes.

Outcome: the help and CLI reference state exactly what each --force value and force_recreate delete, local and remote.
